domains.name: Sediment

domains.name: Gelling
domains.description: Gelled state, reversibility and spoilage relation

domains.name: Protein sagging
domains.description: Vertical protein stripes on the container wall

domains.name: Appearance and sensory
domains.description: Color change vs T0 (visual or L*a*b*) and texture in mouth or on pour

domains.name: Custom observations
domains.description: Three free slots for a one-off parameter, unshaken and shaken, without a catalog change

domains.description: Powder stability descriptors; extension beyond the URS taxonomy

values.label: Very heavy ring (10 mm or more)
5 Very heavy: ring 10 mm or more
5 Very heavy: 20% or more of package volume
0 Zero: no sediment on the bottom
1 Trace: partial ring or coverage in depressions
4 Heavy: about 4 mm, entire bottom covered
5 Very heavy: 5 mm or more, entire bottom covered
SOP: 10 shakes, 180°, medium force, about 5 s

fields.label: Project code
fields.description: Project code referenced read-only from the reference store (NESTMS data in the Blob reference container) (top of the Project > AR > Trial hierarchy)

fields.label: Stability AR number
fields.description: Stability Analysis Request number referenced read-only from the reference store (NESTMS data in the Blob reference container)

fields.label: Trial number
fields.description: Trial number referenced read-only from the reference store (NESTMS data in the Blob reference container)

fields.label: Variant number
fields.description: Variant number within the trial, referenced read-only

fields.label: Sample code
fields.description: Sample code referenced read-only from the reference store (NESTMS data in the Blob reference container)

fields.label: Time point
fields.description: Stability time point from the AR plan (T0, 2W, 1M, 3M, 6M, 9M, 12M, 18M)

fields.label: Storage condition
fields.description: Storage temperature condition from the AR plan (up to six per trial)

fields.label: Formulation class
fields.description: Liquid RTD, powder or VMS; drives which template is offered

fields.label: Product format
fields.description: Package format of the sample under test

fields.label: Container type
fields.description: Container material and closure

fields.label: Nominal package volume
fields.description: Nominal fill volume; basis for percent-of-package-volume measures

fields.label: Fill height
fields.description: Measured fill height in the container; basis for layer-to-fill ratios

fields.label: Storage orientation
fields.description: How the sample was stored (upright, inverted, horizontal)

fields.label: Sample temperature at observation
fields.description: Sample temperature when observed, after equilibration from the storage condition

fields.label: Sample opened previously
fields.description: Whether the container was opened at an earlier time point

fields.label: Shaking protocol
fields.description: SOP: shake 10 times with medium force in a 180° arc (1A>1B>1C>1B>1A), about 5 seconds in total, the same way every pull

fields.label: Shakes applied
fields.description: Number of shakes when the SOP protocol was not followed

fields.label: Result type
fields.description: Scheduled, ad hoc, retest or pull-forward observation

fields.label: Plan status at capture
fields.description: Whether the stability plan was active or cancelled early on failure when this test was captured

fields.label: Observer
fields.description: Entra ID user who captured the observation (system-derived)

fields.label: Observation timestamp
fields.description: When the physical observation was made (system-derived, editable within same day)

fields.label: Test status
fields.description: Draft, submitted or reviewed (system-managed)

fields.label: Overall result
fields.description: Structured overall assessment replacing the 0 to 5 scale

fields.label: Exclude from trend analysis
fields.description: Set when the pull is not representative (e.g. "way too cooked, ignore"); the record is kept but left out of trend charts

fields.label: Exclusion reason
fields.description: Why this pull is excluded

fields.label: Overall comments
fields.description: Free-text context that supplements, never replaces, structured descriptors

fields.label: Lab results source

fields.label: Creaming rating (unshaken)
fields.description: SOP Table 2. Suggested from the ring thickness when measured; confirm or override

fields.label: Cream layer measurable

fields.label: Cream layer thickness
fields.description: Measured thickness of the cream layer

fields.label: Cream layer thickness unit

fields.label: Cream layer description
fields.description: SOP Table 2 words: trace, slight thin ring, distinct 5 to 8 mm, heavy 8 to 10 mm, very heavy 10 mm or more

fields.description: Cream is usually white or pale yellow; strawberry gives pink; real-food recipes can show an oily fat layer (SOP, Mural)

fields.label: Minor spots present

fields.label: Surface coverage

fields.label: Pour-out video

fields.description: What remained in the container after pour-out

fields.label: Shakes in

fields.label: Creaming rating (shaken)

fields.label: Shaken result
fields.description: Fully, partially or not redispersed

fields.label: Residue after shaking
fields.description: What is left when the cream does not shake in: fat ring, flakes, plug at spout, skin or pad

fields.label: Residual cream after shaking
fields.description: Residual cream as percent of original layer

fields.label: Shaken creaming photo
fields.description: Photo evidence after shaking

fields.label: Emulsifier review flag
fields.description: Flag the emulsifier system for formulation review

fields.description: Dried or foamy product on the rim or seal is not creaming (SOP Figures 3 and 4); record it separately

fields.description: SOP touch test: if the ring feels fatty it counts as creaming, not a foaming issue

fields.label: Market restriction flag
fields.description: Emulsifier options are restricted in the target market

fields.label: Creaming review guidance
fields.description: If cream does not redisperse, review emulsifier system and homogenisation pressure

fields.label: Creaming comments
fields.description: Supplementary creaming notes

fields.description: Photo evidence after shaking

fields.description: Is sediment present before shaking

fields.label: Sediment height unit

fields.description: Partial ring, complete ring, outer ring with clear center, entire bottom, depressions only

fields.label: Sediment texture
fields.description: Loose, soft, compact, hard, sticky, lumpy, sandy, flaky

fields.label: Measured
fields.description: Before pouring through a clear bottle, or after pouring in the emptied bottle (SOP default)

fields.label: Measurement location
fields.description: SOP: measure at the outer rim to record the worst case

fields.label: Sediment weight
fields.description: Optional weighing when an empty package is available; more reliable than the 0 to 5 rating (SOP)

fields.label: Bottle cut open to evaluate
fields.description: Opaque bottles may need to be cut to see the sediment (SOP)

fields.label: Bottle coating present (not sediment)
fields.description: Thick product coating the walls after pouring; recorded separately because it is not true sediment

fields.label: Unshaken sediment photo

fields.description: Protein, mineral or cocoa; branches the sub-flow

fields.label: Protein sediment guidance
fields.description: Hard or significant protein sediment, or clumps after shaking: flag to the team; check ionic balance (citrate) and the hydrocolloid system; protein type and level matter (Mural)

fields.label: Mineral sediment appearance
fields.description: Fine powder, gritty or crystalline

fields.label: Mineral sediment guidance
fields.description: Mineral deposits are a compliance concern for label claims: test the sediment and the beverage for minerals and flag to the project team; starch or hydrocolloids can help suspension (SOP, Mural)

fields.label: Cocoa ring present

fields.label: Cocoa sediment guidance
fields.description: Cocoa settling is not necessarily sediment; it usually shakes in. Take a photo and estimate the share of the package affected (Mural)

templates.description: Homogeneity first, then unshaken and shaken creaming, serum and sediment with the SOP 0 to 5 rating suggested from each measurement, plus gelling, rippling and protein sagging. Lab results typed in from LIMS.
Every RTD descriptor including re-separation checks, appearance and sensory, and three custom slots.
The six SOP ratings (creaming, serum, sediment; unshaken and shaken), sediment heights, pH and viscosity, photos and a comment: the team spreadsheet as a form.
Extension template for powder formulations. Fields are outside the URS 127-field count and need PD vocabulary confirmation.
Extension template for tablets, capsules and gummies. Fields are outside the URS 127-field count and need PD vocabulary confirmation.
